title: Max Usage Limit for Master Password Reset in v3.2.0.4?
symptom: After resetting the master password once without an active Omnipod Dash, a second attempt with an active Dash shows no success message and the PasswordReset file in the extra folder no longer disappears. The user asks if the feature has a minimum time interval or can only be used once.
cause: The master password reset feature can only be used once; the file is removed on successful reset. Additionally, when no active pump connection exists, the serial number used as the password defaults to 'n/a'.
fix: The user found that entering 'n/a' as the master password works when there is no active pump connection. The developer changed the code to address this issue.
evidence_quote: I tried "n/a" and it worked 😄 😄 If the result of podStateManager.uniqueId?.toString() is null, it returns the string "n/a" as a default value.
